svg.title: Arduino Uno LED slider breadboard wiring
svg.desc: Breadboard, Arduino Uno (Rev3), potentiometer, pushbutton, LED and resistor graphics are from Fritzing (fritzing-parts), CC BY-SA 3.0. The LCD1602-I2C graphic is the custom part in the class's PotButtonLCD.fzz. Rendered from the class Fritzing file with LED2 on D9 added.
